q: draft a PR description for splitting out the billing service
reply: Here's a draft PR description for the billing service split. Let me know if you want to adjust anything:

Extracts the billing logic from the monolith into a dedicated billing service. This is the next step after the Stripe webhook service split — billing now runs as an independent service with its own deployment lifecycle.
- Moved all Stripe billing operations (subscriptions, invoices, payment methods) to `services/billing/`
- Extracted billing webhook handlers from the shared Stripe webhook service into billing-specific endpoints
- Kept existing GraphQL billing resolvers intact — they now call the billing service internally via gRPC
- Updated deployment configs: new service, new terraform module, new CI pipeline
- **Rollback**: Redeploy previous monolith version. No DB schema changes in this PR.
- **Dry run**: Ran billing operations against staging with no errors. All existing billing tests pass.
- **On-call**: Tom and Lena will cover billing during the first week post-cutover.
- Start with `services/billing/` for the core logic, then check the integration layer in `internal/gateways/billing.go`
- Lena is already familiar from earlier billing PRs — Tom has reviewed the webhook side
- I'll add rollback steps to the cutover checklist separately
